About

Hi, I'm Emil. A creative generalist from Sweden.

“Sometimes you help people with your creations without even realising it.”

I was born in 1989 in Skänninge, a small town in Sweden, and I've been making things for as long as I can remember. These days I live in Tranås, and writing code or making art is still how I'd rather spend my day.

At 20, a friend and I started our own agency, Delive – Web Solutions, and some of the brands we made for those first clients are still around today. Later I moved into 3D art and game development, and I've since worked with people all over the world on websites, tools and games.

Based in
